children.text: 第 1 轮：请解释一下增量同步里「上次扫描的最大时间戳」作为停止条件的含义。
第 1 轮回答：停止条件以「上次扫描的最大时间戳」为准——扫描按时间倒序进行，一旦遇到更新时间早于（或等于）该时间戳且内容未变更的记录即停止，保证增量扫描收敛。

Round 3: compare the trade-offs of bundling CJK fonts vs local-first loading.

Round 3 answer: when a message has multiple children (branches), only the selected leaf path is exported. Sibling branches stay in storage but are excluded from the render tree, and `selectedLeafMessageId` records which path won.
